title: Country & Fiscal Regime
confirmBody: Changing country or VAT regime switches the fiscal system for new receipts. Historical invoices are preserved under the original country regime.
confirmAffected: {{count}} existing fiscal documents are affected and stay under the previous country.
incompatibleBlocked: This change is not allowed. {{count}} signed documents would be invalid under the new country.
success: Country and fiscal regime were updated.
saveFailed: Could not update country and fiscal regime.
lockedFiscal: Country cannot be changed after fiscal data exists.
viewOnly: View only. Changes are reserved for Super Administrators.
